item.title: The Show Goes On for Manhattan Youth's Production of 'The Nutcracker'
item.description: The Show Goes On For Manhattan Youth's Nutcracker Performance Battery Park City Despite Sandy's destruction of costumes and set-making supplies, nearly 200 children took the stage. The nearly 200 children from Manhattan Youth’s 18 afterschool dance classes came together on the P.S./I.S. 89 stage on Saturday, Dec. 15.
